comparison.method: Audit every changed runtime/build/test file against the five actual unit call paths, then verify exact direct-source and conservative dependency subtree identity. This is a bounded manual consumer review, not a claim of an automatically complete static call graph.

reasoning.scope: Native UIScrollView window/viewport lifetime, weak ownership, generation checks, outgoing/incoming chat isolation and deferred readiness.
reasoning.unchanged_execution: All 11 tests create their own UIWindow/UIScrollView and call ChatScrollViewHandle directly. The handle and layout value/controller source are byte-identical. They do not instantiate ChatView, ChatBubbleView, approval UI, Settings or the HTTP acceptance provider.
reasoning.changed_consumers: The pending activity AX identifier and consent colors are downstream UI consumers, not inputs to the tested handle. These passes do not cover the still-failed real ChatView rotation/reattachment UI case.

reasoning.scope: Approval summaries, presentation profiles, round grouping, citation evidence/aliases/anchors/favicon projection, transcript replay and coordinator cancellation ownership.
reasoning.unchanged_execution: All 21 test bodies and their in-source fixture strings are byte-identical. The entire AgentActivity implementation subtree, citation projection/model, immutable source references, recorder/lifecycle logic and app stream model are unchanged.
reasoning.changed_consumers: The tests call AgentToolApprovalSummary and domain/citation projections directly; they do not render HanlinInlineToolApproval or call the UI03 HTTP journey. The pending-row AX modifier is in a UI consumer and does not change these models, grouping, approval disposition, or source ownership. None of the three changed catalog keys is an exercised summary/title assertion.

reasoning.scope: Exact legacy UUID suffix removal, user-label preservation and routing-name fallback.
reasoning.unchanged_execution: Both test bodies and HanlinModelDisplayName are byte-identical. They call Foundation string/UUID logic directly. The default fallback localization key Model is unchanged; explicit fallback fixture strings are unchanged.
reasoning.changed_consumers: No modified UI-only file is called. The updated Message/reference_materials/资料内容 translations are unrelated inputs.

reasoning.scope: History/live/permission phases, true operation activity, shimmer ownership, lazy detail projection, request receipts and semantic-output transitions.
reasoning.unchanged_execution: All 14 tests and the entire AgentActivity domain subtree are byte-identical, including HeaderPhase, VisibilityPolicy, TitleBuilder, Composer, EventAccumulator, ProviderEventAdapter and transcript validation. ClassicChatAgentProjection is unchanged.
reasoning.changed_consumers: These tests resolve domain enums/paths and projections; none mounts the activityRow SwiftUI branch whose AX identifier changed. ColorScheme and approval card fills do not enter the domain decisions. Relevant localized titles are unchanged.

reasoning.scope: Coordinate/name composition, denial/cancellation propagation, original legacy dispatcher outcome and map append behavior, weather service rejection.
reasoning.unchanged_execution: Seven test bodies / eleven actual argument invocations are byte-identical. MapServices, the real APIManager legacy dispatcher, WeatherServices, NativeToolResult/Context, SwiftData models and shared Apple location service/contracts are unchanged. Coordinates/errors are explicit closures, and each dispatcher test owns a fresh in-memory ToolKeys database. The configured empty-key weather fixture rejects before network.
reasoning.changed_consumers: No changed Settings/consent view or UI03 protocol fixture is used by these tests. The Your current location localization key is unchanged. These passes do not attest physical-device authorization prompts or live Core Location updates.

tracked_workspace.qualification: The original CI build truthfully records generated tracked changes. Do not describe it as a pristine checkout or infer same build inputs solely from source SHA. New source-specific generated provenance changes digest by design; compare relevant generated content/build recipe, not blanket hash equality.
